text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't a bad performance, and I think 
everyone watching enjoyed it, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I wanted to take 1st 
place and make you happy.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What did you think of today's results, 
Trainer-kun, my number one fan?
choice_data_list:
That was a great race, and we gained a lot 
from it!
I really want to see you take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
What did you think of today's results, 
Trainer-chan, my number one fan?
choice_data_list:
That was a great race, and we gained a lot 
from it!
I really want to see you take 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right...! I tried to return 
as much love as I possibly could!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's do an emergency "good work" 
livestream today! We can receive 
everyone's love again there and—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll make sure to return the 
greatest love of all!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, that's true, isn't it? This isn't 
enough to deliver the ultimate love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Since I've received the greatest love, I 
have to return it with the greatest love♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Let's start preparing for the next race 
right away. This time, I'll definitely 
deliver 1st place to everyone!"
